dataset.name: Product support — one account, one year
dataset.description: Synthetic English support conversations between one customer and the support team of a fictional analytics product, over a year. A Latin-script corpus with short factual turns, dates and identifiers — the mirror of the Farsi diary, and the corpus where an ASCII embedder is genuinely competitive rather than scoring at chance. All names, products and events are fictional.

messages.content: Hi — Invoice INV-2291 was charged twice on 4 November. We were billed the same amount by two different card attempts and the second one went through as well. Can you look into it?
I can see both charges on the account. I've raised a refund request with billing; these usually clear within three working days.
Any news on the double charge from Tuesday?
Yes — The duplicate charge of $480 was refunded on 7 November. It should appear on the card statement within two working days, under the original invoice number.
Something is wrong with our reporting exports. CSV exports over 50,000 rows truncate silently — we compared a 62,000-row export against the dashboard and the file stopped at 50,000 with no warning.
Thank you, that is reproducible here. I've filed it as a data-loss bug rather than a limit, because nothing in the file says it was cut.
Is there a workaround for the export problem while we wait?
Export by month rather than by quarter, or use the API with pagination. Both return the full set.
Our dashboards were down this morning. What happened?
There was an incident: the EU cluster was unavailable for 43 minutes on 12 January. Ingestion continued throughout, so no data was lost — only the read path was affected.
Can you send the post-mortem?
Published today: a failed migration on the metrics database caused the January outage. The migration has been rolled back and the replica promotion is now automatic.
We need SSO before we can roll Meridian out to the whole company.
Understood. It is on the roadmap and we will ship SAML SSO before the end of Q2. I'll keep this thread open so you hear it from us rather than from the changelog.
How long do you keep audit logs? Our security review is asking.
On your plan, audit logs are kept for 90 days on the Growth plan. Enterprise extends that to 400 days, and export to your own bucket is available on both.
Who is our account manager now? Our emails to Tom are bouncing.
Priya Raman took over the Northwind account in February, so she is your contact from now on. Tom left at the end of January.
Quick check on plan limits: the Growth plan includes 25 seats, correct? We are at 24.
That's right for the current term. If you add a 26th user the plan will prompt for an upgrade at renewal rather than blocking the invite.
Our webhooks to the warehouse fail sometimes. How many times do you retry?
Currently webhook retries stop after 5 attempts over 30 minutes, with exponential backoff. Failed deliveries stay in the queue view for seven days so you can replay them.
Dashboards feel much faster this week. Did something change?
Yes — we shipped query caching for saved views. Measured across all customers, p95 dashboard load time went from 3.1 s to 1.4 s after the caching change.
Are you going to charge us for the extra seats we added mid-term?
No. Mid-term additions are pro-rated at renewal, and nothing is charged before that date.
We saw an email about plan changes. Does it affect us?
It does, in your favour: from 1 April the Growth plan includes 40 seats, at the same price. Your renewal in July will show the new allowance.
Is the export bug fixed? We are about to run the annual report.
It is — the export truncation was fixed in release 4.8.2, which is on your workspace since Monday. The 62,000-row case now completes with a row count in the footer.
Priya, can we get a rough date for SSO? The security review is asking again.
Still inside the quarter. The identity work is in staging now and we are testing against Okta and Entra.
The SSO announcement just landed. Is it on our workspace?
SAML SSO shipped on 18 June, and your workspace is in the first wave. The setup guide is in the admin area under Authentication.
Renewal quote please, with the new seat count.
Sent. It renews on 31 July at the Growth rate with the larger allowance, and no pro-rating is owed for the seats you added in March.
One of our analysts says the API returns different totals than the UI.
That is timezone rather than data: the API defaults to UTC and your workspace displays in Europe/Berlin. Pass tz=Europe/Berlin and they match.
Thanks for the year — anything we should know before renewal?
Only the seat change and SSO, both already on your workspace. Nothing else about your plan changes at renewal.
